SECTION_C3_BLOCKER_CLOSED.the_defect_restated_from_repository_text: v1.0.0 models the recovery point PER WINDOW (FRESHNESS.one_window_only; S8.retest_after 'before every apply') but states the posture ONCE, at OWNER_DECISIONS[OD-3], with a posture space whose ground (ADJUDICATIONS.I.THE_LIVE_RUNTIME_COMPLICATION) presupposes that PR #201 has bound a runtime. The programme has two DDL events whose writer topology is opposite: the initial corpus alignment, which can occur before any runtime binding exists, and FIBDB-053 Stage-A, whose own owner decision RC-09 requires the runtime to be deployed BEFORE the SQL. One posture cannot be correct for both: an empty-window proof is structurally impossible for the second, and accepting write loss is unnecessary for the first.
SECTION_C3_BLOCKER_CLOSED.closure_mechanism: SECTION_C4 replaces the single posture with a CLOSED registry keyed by event class. The class is DERIVED from the units of the window's MIGRATION_CORPUS_PACKET, the posture is READ from the registry, and every precondition, invalidator, evidence item and STOP code is a field of the class entry. A future evaluator answers what event this is, what posture applies, what evidence is required, what invalidates it and what stops it, from this artifact alone.

SECTION_C4_EVENT_CLASS_REGISTRY.rule: CLOSED ENUMERATION. Exactly two event classes carry a posture. Every other window is UNKNOWN and STOPS. The executor never chooses a posture; it derives a class and reads the posture.

classification.input: For every unit enumerated in the window's MIGRATION_CORPUS_PACKET (HDP-4): its unit_membership, derived from the exact release SHA the packet binds.

unit_membership_values.FIBDB053_STAGE_A_UNIT: The unit is one of the four FIBDB-053 Stage-A artifacts enumerated at docs/ops/wave3/FIBDB053_STAGE_A_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json PROTECTED_WRITE_SET.ordered_literals[0..3] (stella_0017b in its prepared, rollback, hosted and governed forms), or any governed successor of that exact unit. This membership TAKES PRECEDENCE: a stella_0017b unit is FIBDB053_STAGE_A_UNIT even if the certified SHA's hosted chain also lists it.
unit_membership_values.S1_EXACT_CORPUS_UNIT: Any other unit of the exact migration corpus that gate S1 compares the staging journal against at the certified SHA (the corpus of db/migrations/meta/_journal.json and the hosted package chain governed by gate S2), applied to bring the staging journal toward S1 parity.

rules.when: The unit list is non-empty and EVERY unit has unit_membership S1_EXACT_CORPUS_UNIT.
The unit list is non-empty and EVERY unit has unit_membership FIBDB053_STAGE_A_UNIT.
Anything else: an empty list, a MIXED list, a unit with any other membership, or a unit whose membership is UNKNOWN.

classification.mixed_windows_are_prohibited: A window that would apply units of both classes is UNKNOWN and STOPS. The two classes carry different postures and one recovery point cannot be governed by two postures at once; the units must be split into separate windows, each with its own recovery point (v1.0.0 FRESHNESS.one_window_only).
classification.declared_class_must_agree: The execution lane ALSO declares the class in writing. The declaration and the derivation must be equal; a missing declaration or a disagreement STOPS with STOP_EVENT_CLASS_DECLARATION_MISMATCH. Neither alone is sufficient.

C3_EMPTY_WINDOW_BY_CONSTRUCTION.origin: Sub-option C-3 of quiesce OD-Q5 (blob 1abcefc4, SECTION_B8), selected by the owner for Event A in STAGING_RECOVERY_OWNER_DECISIONS_v1.0.1.
C3_EMPTY_WINDOW_BY_CONSTRUCTION.meaning: The no-intervening-mutation predicate of v1.0.0 FRESHNESS is established POSITIVELY because no client or writer of any kind exists against the governed project for the whole window, and no act that could create one occurs inside it. It is NOT 'assume nobody is writing': it holds only on the governed census evidence of SECTION_C5, re-taken at the instants SECTION_C5 names.
C3_EMPTY_WINDOW_BY_CONSTRUCTION.accepted_lost_writes: ZERO. The owner's refusal of intentional write loss (v1.0.0 OD-3 statement) is PRESERVED for Event A.
C3_EMPTY_WINDOW_BY_CONSTRUCTION.absence_of_evidence_is_not_evidence_of_a: A census that did not look, could not look, or returned UNKNOWN does not establish this posture.

ACCEPT_BOUNDED_STAGING_WRITE_LOSS.origin: The parent's own ACCEPT posture (v1.0.0 ADJUDICATIONS.I_maximum_permitted_age.THE_LIVE_RUNTIME_COMPLICATION.consequence: 'writes in the window are accepted as lost on restore and that acceptance is recorded in writing with a bounded rationale'), which is sub-option C-1 of quiesce OD-Q5, selected by the owner for Event B only.
ACCEPT_BOUNDED_STAGING_WRITE_LOSS.meaning: Unexpected, non-intentional writes to the governed STAGING target inside a QUANTIFIED, bounded exposure interval are accepted as lost if a restore is performed. Nothing else is accepted.
what_it_is_not: It is not normal operation during the window: SECTION_C6 requires a planned maintenance posture with no intentional traffic.
It is not an unbounded or undefined window: SECTION_C7 requires the interval to be quantified before the human confirmation that accepts it.
It is not permission to skip Recovery: every S8 requirement of SECTION_C9 still binds.
It is not QUIESCE and may not be labelled QUIESCE, partial QUIESCE or any prevention posture.
It is never applicable to production and creates no production precedent.

It was measured unexecutable over the effective writer set (quiesce amendment blob 1abcefc4, SECTION_B7 CG-Q4). Re-applying it to any class requires a NEW owner decision.

C2_PARTIAL_QUIESCE.rule: No window may quiesce only the PR #201-bound runtime and call the remaining exposure QUIESCE, and no evidence may carry a C2 label, explicitly or implicitly. SECTION_C4_EVENT_CLASS_REGISTRY.no_fallback_between_postures: A class that fails its own posture STOPS. Event A may not fall back to ACCEPT; Event B may not claim C3; neither may fall back to QUIESCE.

SECTION_C4_EVENT_CLASS_REGISTRY.fact_semantics: Each required fact is recorded by the execution lane as a string. A value equal to `required` passes. A missing value or a value in `unknown_values` STOPS with `stop_on_unknown`. Any other value STOPS with `stop_on_mismatch`. UNKNOWN never passes and never becomes the class's posture.

EVENT_A_INITIAL_CORPUS.lifecycle_position: BEFORE any PR #201 act. The empty-window model is available only while no client of any kind exists against the governed project; PR #201's AUTH-1/AUTH-2 create one.

Owner condition: any evidence of an active writer or client STOPS. Includes EXPOSED surfaces (census errata v1.0.2 SECTION_C5): exposure without measured occupancy is not NONE_FOUND.
Owner condition: PR #201 has not executed. Established by SECTION_C5.PR201_EXECUTION_STATE, never by branch state alone. PARTIALLY_EXECUTED is a mismatch.
SECTION_C5.freshness. STALE and VOID are mismatches.

required_facts.basis: SECTION_C7. Derived by validating the exposure record, never asserted.
Owner condition: exposure quantified before human confirmation. SECTION_C13 HC-2-B.

EVENT_B_STAGE_A.pr201_absence_is_not_carried: EA-F4 is a field of EVENT_A_INITIAL_CORPUS only. UNKNOWN.rule: No posture. No default. No nearest match. A window that is neither class requires a new owner decision before any posture can apply to it.

required_predicates_conjunctive: EA-P1 A governed census (EA-F1) classifies the target C3_AVAILABLE (EA-F2) under the census authority's SECTION_G as then effective after its errata and certification.
EA-P2 No relevant client or writer is active and no write surface is exposed without measured occupancy (EA-F3). Any evidence of an active client or writer STOPS; UNKNOWN STOPS.
EA-P3 PR #201 has not executed, in whole or in part (EA-F4), established by PR201_EXECUTION_STATE below. UNKNOWN STOPS.
EA-P4 The census is FRESH (EA-F5) and its deciding observations are re-taken negative at W1 (EA-F6).
EA-P5 The recovery point and DDL sequencing satisfy every common S8 requirement of SECTION_C9.
EA-P6 Every other precondition the effective chain already imposes still holds unchanged: v1.0.0 PRESTATE PS-1..PS-6 and HOSTED_DDL_PRECONDITIONS HDP-1..HDP-5.

PR201_EXECUTION_STATE.rule: NOT_EXECUTED is established ONLY by the conjunction of both sources below at the execution lane's own head and instant. Branch state alone is never sufficient, and a merged PR is not an executed PR.
PR201_EXECUTION_STATE.repository_source: The PR #201 execution authority (docs/ops/release/FIBDB053_RUNTIME_STAGING_BINDING_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json, blob 6549cd9c at this base) still declares final_state FIBDB053_RUNTIME_STAGING_BINDING_AUTHORITY_AUTHORED__NOT_EXECUTED, and no execution-lane record, evidence artifact or successor in the repository records any AUTH-1 or AUTH-2 act.
PR201_EXECUTION_STATE.live_source: The governed census's Tier 1 observations return no branch-scoped Preview row for any of the three PR #201 variables (census rule G-N1 not fired) and no DSN-bearing row with a READY deployment in scope (G-N2 not fired).

values.PARTIALLY_EXECUTED: any AUTH-1 binding exists without AUTH-2, or any other partial signature
values.UNKNOWN: either source unavailable, errored, incomplete or contradictory

PR201_EXECUTION_STATE.contradiction_rule: If the repository says NOT_EXECUTED and the live source shows an execution signature, the value is EXECUTED, not UNKNOWN: the live world controls over a declared state, and the declared state is then stale.

freshness.model: EVENT-BASED, carried from RULE_OBSERVATION_FRESHNESS and census SECTION_H.freshness. No clock TTL is introduced: v1.0.0 J.explicitly_NOT_invalidating excludes the passage of time alone, and the census rule already requires the age to be STATED. Both are preserved.
freshness.one_window_only: A C3 classification and its evidence are consumed by exactly ONE Event A window. They are not reusable for a second window, a second attempt, or any Event B window.

invalidators.rule: The occurrence of ANY of these after the deciding census observation and before the window closes makes the C3 evidence VOID, not merely stale. Void evidence is never revived; a fresh census and a fresh recovery point are required. Vocabulary follows census SECTION_H.freshness.the_void_events, extended only to name its classes explicitly.

events.event: PR #201 executes in whole or in part (any AUTH-1 binding or any AUTH-2 deployment).
Any deployment is created, promoted or rebuilt on any project the census enumerates (deployment mutation).
Any environment variable is created, edited or deleted on any enumerated project, in any scope (environment binding mutation).
Any Supabase hosted configuration change on the governed project: Auth, Data API, Storage, Realtime, extensions, network restrictions, read-only mode or its override.

Any credential mutation that changes client capability: API key or publishable/secret key creation, rotation, enablement or disablement; JWT secret change; database password change; role, grant or membership change.
Any new runtime activation: a deployment, function, worker, cron, queue consumer, webhook or edge function that could reach the governed project.
Creation of a Supabase preview branch, or any change of the project's status.

Any other writer-enabling provider act, and any governed or ungoverned act that could create a client or writer (including an operator console session, W-12, W-15 or W-16 of the quiesce writer inventory).

Any v1.0.0 ADJUDICATIONS.J invalidating event for the recovery point, unchanged: any mutation of the target after capture, a DDL not applied in the named window, target identity change, loss of artifact integrity or custody, a change of the corpus SHA, modification of the artifact, or a failed capture.

evidence.item: The census evidence package in the census authority's SECTION_H shape, with its output contract (classification, triggering_rule_ids, observation_ids_relied_on, observation_timestamp_utc, unknown_reasons, freshness_statement).
The PR201_EXECUTION_STATE record naming both sources and their values.
The W1 re-observation of the deciding observations, with timestamps, and the statement that no EA-INV event occurred between the deciding census and W1.
The event_class declaration EVENT_A_INITIAL_CORPUS and the per-unit membership derivation of the MIGRATION_CORPUS_PACKET.
The common S8 evidence of SECTION_C9.

SECTION_C5_EVENT_A_C3_CONTRACT.C3_proves_only_the_empty_window: C3 establishes the no-client, no-intervening-writer predicate. It does NOT prove backup integrity, restorability or restore capability; those remain SECTION_C9 and D1.

MEASURED_CURRENT_REACHABILITY.statement: Under the census authority as authored at blob 52418809 and its errata, C3_AVAILABLE is UNREACHABLE: its condition A-4 requires Tier 2 observations the census does not confer (DEP-C1), and the census states in terms that it 'CAN NEVER RETURN C3_AVAILABLE' as authorized. The census authority is also uncertified at its latest errata.
MEASURED_CURRENT_REACHABILITY.consequence: EVENT_A_INITIAL_CORPUS is authorized as a posture but is CURRENTLY NOT SATISFIABLE: until DEP-C1 is resolved (census OD-C1, or the Tier 2 route via the FIBDB-053 D-1 observation authority) and the census authority is certified, every Event A evaluation STOPS at EA-F1 or EA-F2. This is disclosed here so it is not discovered at execution time, and it is NOT relaxed: reading C3_UNKNOWN as C3_AVAILABLE would convert absence of evidence into evidence of absence.

required_predicates_conjunctive: EB-P1 Target is the governed staging ref bvyzblhqymxruxdguaee, structurally verified by verifyStagingTarget with the production veto evaluated first (CF-1, EV-1). Any production target STOPS. UNKNOWN staging identity STOPS.
EB-P2 Staging only, never production. The acceptance is void for any other target.
EB-P3 A scheduled maintenance window is declared in writing before HC-2-B (EB-F1).
EB-P4 The exposure is quantified under SECTION_C7 BEFORE the human confirmation that accepts it (EB-F2, EB-F3).
EB-P5 No commercial pilot or user session is intentionally active (EB-F4, PILOT_SESSION_PREDICATE).
EB-P6 No intentional application traffic during the exposure (EB-F5, TRAFFIC_POSTURE).
EB-P7 A governed recovery point is taken and verified immediately before the DDL, per every common S8 requirement of SECTION_C9.

EB-P8 Every precondition the effective chain and the Stage-A chain already impose still holds unchanged: v1.0.0 PRESTATE PS-1..PS-6, HDP-1..HDP-5, the FIBDB-053 Stage-A authority, the Wave 3 G2 boundary, RUNTIME_APPLY_COUPLING and RC-09. This amendment grants none of them and relaxes none of them.

PILOT_SESSION_PREDICATE.predicate: NONE_INTENTIONALLY_ACTIVE: for the whole exposure interval, no commercial pilot, customer, UAT or user session is intentionally operating against governed staging, no such session is scheduled to start, and no pilot participant has been invited or directed to use staging.
PILOT_SESSION_PREDICATE.how_established: By a WRITTEN attestation of the owner (or the owner-designated operator of the pilot programme), recorded before HC-2-B and bound by digest into the exposure record's maintenance_state_predicate.pilot_session_attestation_ref. Where a governed observation mechanism exists under a separately certified authority, its result is attached as well.
PILOT_SESSION_PREDICATE.mechanism_status: NO AUTOMATED OBSERVATION MECHANISM IS CURRENTLY AUTHORIZED. The predicate is therefore established by attestation and is recorded AS an attestation, never as a measurement. This artifact does not claim a mechanism exists.
PILOT_SESSION_PREDICATE.UNKNOWN: If the attestation cannot be given, is conditional, or names any active or scheduled session, the value is UNKNOWN or ACTIVE and the window STOPS.
PILOT_SESSION_PREDICATE.distinction_from_global_quiescence: This predicate is about INTENTIONALLY operated pilot and user sessions. It is NOT full global quiescence of every possible writer. Full global quiescence is explicitly NOT required for Event B (KEEP_FULL_SCOPE_QUIESCE_FOR_EVENT_B = NO).

during_the_exposure_interval: No intentionally generated application traffic against governed staging.
No intentionally started user or pilot session.
No deliberate test traffic that writes to governed staging, unless it is explicitly authorized by another exact authority named by path and clause in the exposure record.
Read-only observations required by an exact authority (for example the post-DDL health observation OD-6 requires) are permitted only under that authority and must be named in the exposure record.
TRAFFIC_POSTURE.unexpected_writes: Unexpected external, provider or client writes that cannot be globally prevented fall within the explicitly accepted bounded staging exposure. They must never be intentionally generated. An intentionally generated write is not inside the acceptance and invalidates the window (EB-INV-1).

FULL_SCOPE_QUIESCE_NOT_REQUIRED.rule: Event B is NOT blocked because the provider lacks a demonstrable mechanism to prevent every possible writer. That blocker (quiesce amendment SECTION_B7, CG-Q4) is superseded FOR EVENT B ONLY by the bounded ACCEPT posture.
FULL_SCOPE_QUIESCE_NOT_REQUIRED.scope_limit: The relaxation applies only to Event B on the governed staging target. It does not apply to Event A, to any UNKNOWN class, or to production, and it creates no production precedent.

SECTION_C7_EVENT_B_BOUNDED_EXPOSURE_CONT.rule: ACCEPT_BOUNDED_STAGING_WRITE_LOSS is valid only against ONE exposure record that satisfies every field and every validation below. The duration is NOT set by this authority; it is quantified by the execution lane for its own window and accepted by a human who sees it.

window_semantics.start: window_start_utc is the capture snapshot instant of the governed recovery point (W0, the anchor preserved by the quiesce amendment SECTION_B11). Writes after W0 are not in the recovery point and are the exposure.
window_semantics.end: The window closes at the FIRST of: (a) completion of the governed DDL followed by the positive health observation OD-6 condition 2 requires; (b) completion of a restore if recovery is invoked; (c) abort of the window before the first DDL statement.
window_semantics.bound: window_end_utc, max_bounded_duration_seconds, or both. If both are given, the earlier bound governs.

required_fields.rule: equals the staging_project_ref, structurally derived; a production ref STOPS with STOP_PRODUCTION_TARGET
at least one present; window_end_utc strictly after window_start_utc; max_bounded_duration_seconds a positive finite integer
non-empty; content digest plus storage locator class per v1.0.0 H
ISO-8601 UTC instant, not before capture_started_at_utc

non-empty statement of how the bound was derived from the planned sequence (capture, integrity, window-artifact rehearsal, confirmation, DDL, health observation), measured by the execution lane, never copied from this authority
ISO-8601 UTC instant strictly BEFORE the HC-2-B confirmation instant

SECTION_C7_EVENT_B_BOUNDED_EXPOSURE_CONT.no_value_may_be_UNKNOWN: Any field whose value is missing, empty or UNKNOWN makes the exposure unbounded for the purpose of this contract.
SECTION_C7_EVENT_B_BOUNDED_EXPOSURE_CONT.STOP: STOP_UNBOUNDED_STAGING_WRITE_LOSS_EXPOSURE if the exposure cannot be bounded or quantified, or if any validation fails. STOP_EXPOSURE_NOT_QUANTIFIED_BEFORE_CONFIRMATION if quantified_at_utc is not strictly before the HC-2-B confirmation.

bound_enforcement.before_the_first_DDL_statement: If the remaining bound cannot cover the planned DDL and health observation, the window STOPS: the DDL is not started, the recovery point is treated as stale, and a new record, a new recovery point and a new HC-2-B are required.
bound_enforcement.after_the_first_DDL_statement: If the bound is exceeded, the fact is recorded as EXPOSURE_BOUND_EXCEEDED, which is a FAILED GATE for the window and is reported to the owner. The acceptance does NOT extend itself; writes after the bound are outside what the owner accepted. The pre-DDL artifact remains under OD-6's destruction conditions.
bound_enforcement.no_automatic_extension: A bound is never extended in flight. Extension means a new record and a new confirmation, possible only before the first DDL statement.

SECTION_C7_EVENT_B_BOUNDED_EXPOSURE_CONT.closure_evidence: After the window closes, the actual start, the actual end, whether the bound held, and which closure condition (a), (b) or (c) occurred are recorded against the record_id.

SECTION_C8_EVENT_B_INVALIDATORS_AND_OD_3.why_this_section_exists: v1.0.0 FRESHNESS and ADJUDICATIONS.J were written before any posture was selected and read 'ANY mutation ... including application write' as invalidating. Under ACCEPT, which the parent itself defined, unexpected writes in the window are accepted as lost. The parent's own ACCEPT definition therefore requires those clauses to be read, FOR EVENT B ONLY, as follows. For Event A they are unchanged.
